data.name: Server_TraceLevel
data.value: The least level of a trace message that is written to the logs: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical or None.

data.name: Server_Verbose
data.value: Whether verbose messages are written. They may contain document locations, symbol names and stack traces.

data.name: Server_WireErrorDetail
data.value: How the source paths in the error details a component sends another are written: RepoRelative, FileName or Redacted.

data.name: Server_ConnectTimeoutSeconds
data.value: How many seconds a client waits for a server to connect before it gives up.

data.name: Server_HealthCheckIntervalSeconds
data.value: How many seconds pass between health checks: how long a server outlives a client that stopped answering.

data.name: Server_ShutdownTimeoutSeconds
data.value: How many seconds a server waits for the Exit notification after a Shutdown request.

data.name: Server_MaxRestartAttempts
data.value: How many times a component that failed is restarted before its failure is reported.

data.name: Server_RestartBackoffBaseMs
data.value: How many milliseconds pass before the first restart of a component that failed; the delay doubles with each attempt.

data.name: Server_RestartBackoffMaxMs
data.value: The longest delay between two restarts of a component that failed, in milliseconds.

data.name: Workspace_DefaultLocation
data.value: The folder a relative workspace location is in.

data.name: Workspace_WorkspaceUri
data.value: The workspace a client opens when it is given none.

data.name: Workspace_Language
data.value: The language workspaces are written in: vba, vb6 or basic.

data.name: Workspace_EnableFileSystemWatchers
data.value: Whether the language server watches the workspace's files itself, for an editor that does not. Off, a file changed outside the editor is read when the server next starts.

data.name: Platform_Extensions_Allowed
data.value: The extensions the platform loads, by their title, separated by commas. An extension runs code of its own, with the platform's rights.

data.name: Environment_Is64Bit
data.value: Whether the environment is a 64-bit one: the width of LongPtr, and what #If Win64 says.

data.name: Environment_Lcid
data.value: The locale identifier of the environment; 0 is the invariant locale.

data.name: Environment_AnsiCodePage
data.value: The ANSI code page a String is converted to and from bytes with, and that Chr and Asc use.

data.name: Environment_SupportsOptionCompareDatabase
data.value: Whether the Option Compare Database directive is allowed, as Microsoft Access allows it.

data.name: Environment_DatabaseCompare
data.value: How Option Compare Database compares strings: Text or Binary.

data.name: Environment_ErlLineNumbering
data.value: What Erl gives: the line the error was raised on (DocumentLine), or the last line number before it, as MS-VBA does (LineLabel).

data.name: Environment_AllowDllImports
data.value: Whether a procedure a Declare statement imports from a library may be called. A library call can run any code at all on this machine.

data.name: Environment_AllowAutomation
data.value: Whether a program may create and call the objects of another application or library: Excel, Word, Scripting.

data.name: Environment_LegacyRegistrySettings
data.value: Whether SaveSetting, GetSetting, GetAllSettings and DeleteSetting use the Windows Registry, as MS-VBA does, instead of the workspace's settings.

data.name: Environment_Regional_DecimalSymbol
data.value: What separates the whole part of a number from its fraction.

data.name: Environment_Regional_DigitGroupingSymbol
data.value: What groups the digits of a number.

data.name: Environment_Regional_CurrencySymbol
data.value: What an amount of money is written with.

data.name: Environment_Regional_TwoDigitYearMax
data.value: The last year a year written with two digits can be: with 2049, 30 is 2030 and 50 is 1950.

data.name: Environment_Regional_ShortDatePattern
data.value: The Short Date format a date is written in.

data.name: Environment_Regional_LongTimePattern
data.value: The Long Time format a time is written in.

data.name: Environment_Regional_AMDesignator
data.value: What a time before noon is written with.

data.name: Environment_Regional_PMDesignator
data.value: What a time from noon on is written with.

data.name: Formatting_IndentEntireProcedureBody
data.value: Whether the body of a procedure is indented a level from its Sub, Function or Property line and its End.

data.name: Formatting_IndentEnumTypeAsProcedure
data.value: Whether the body of an Enum or a Type is indented a level, as the body of a procedure is.

data.name: Formatting_IndentFirstCommentBlock
data.value: Whether the comments at the top of a module, before its first declaration, are indented a level.

data.name: Formatting_IndentFirstDeclarationBlock
data.value: Whether the declarations at the top of a procedure, before its first statement, are indented a level.

data.name: Formatting_IgnoreEmptyLinesInFirstBlocks
data.value: Whether the empty lines in the first comment block and the first declaration block are ignored when those blocks are found.

data.name: Formatting_AlignCommentsWithCode
data.value: Whether a comment on a line of its own is indented as the code that follows it.

data.name: Formatting_AlignContinuations
data.value: Whether the lines a statement continues onto are aligned with each other.

data.name: Formatting_IgnoreOperatorsInContinuations
data.value: Whether an operator that begins a continued line is ignored when continuations are aligned, so that the operands line up.

data.name: Formatting_IndentCase
data.value: Whether the Case clauses of a Select Case are indented a level from the Select Case.

data.name: Formatting_ForceDebugStatementsInColumn1
data.value: Whether Debug.Print, Debug.Assert and Stop all go in the first column, whatever is set for each.

data.name: Formatting_ForceDebugPrintInColumn1
data.value: Whether Debug.Print goes in the first column.

data.name: Formatting_ForceDebugAssertInColumn1
data.value: Whether Debug.Assert goes in the first column.

data.name: Formatting_ForceStopInColumn1
data.value: Whether Stop goes in the first column.

data.name: Formatting_ForceCompilerDirectivesInColumn1
data.value: Whether the lines of conditional compilation (#If, #Else, #End If, #Const) go in the first column.

data.name: Formatting_IndentCompilerDirectives
data.value: Whether the code between the lines of conditional compilation is indented a level.

data.name: Formatting_AlignDims
data.value: Whether the As clauses of consecutive declarations are aligned in a column.

data.name: Formatting_AlignDimColumn
data.value: The column the As clauses of declarations are aligned in, from 0 to 100.

data.name: Formatting_EndOfLineCommentStyle
data.value: Where a comment at the end of a line of code goes: where it was written (Absolute), the gap it was written with (SameGap), two spaces after the code (StandardGap), or in a column (AlignInColumn).

data.name: Formatting_EndOfLineCommentColumnSpaceAlignment
data.value: The column a comment at the end of a line is aligned in when the style is AlignInColumn, from 0 to 100.

data.name: Formatting_EmptyLineHandlingMethod
data.value: What is done with lines that have nothing on them: left as they are (Ignore), removed (Remove), or indented as the code around them (Indent).

data.name: Formatting_IndentSpaces
data.value: The number of spaces a level of indentation is, from 0 to 32. Left unset, it is your editor's tab size.

data.name: Formatting_VerticallySpaceProcedures
data.value: Whether the number of empty lines between the procedures of a module is made the number set for it.

data.name: Formatting_LinesBetweenProcedures
data.value: The number of empty lines between procedures, from 0 to 2, when they are spaced.

data.name: Formatting_GroupRelatedProperties
data.value: Whether the Get, Let and Set of a property are kept together, one after another.

data.name: Formatting_FormatOnType
data.value: Whether the line just finished is formatted, and the new one indented, when you press Enter.

data.name: Formatting_CompleteBlocks
data.value: Whether pressing Enter after a block opener that has no closer inserts the closer and leaves the caret in the indented body.

data.name: Formatting_Snippets
data.value: Whether completion offers snippets of blocks, with placeholders to tab between.

data.name: Formatting_SnippetDimPlacement
data.value: Where the Dim a snippet declares goes: right above the block (AboveBlock), where it follows the variable's name as you type it, or at the top of the procedure (ProcedureTop).

data.name: Formatting_PrettyList
data.value: Whether a finished line is listed back from what it compiled to, as the VBA editor does, instead of formatted by rules of spacing and casing.
